solve_mip_nash: solve for the optimal Nash equilibrium of a two-player general-sum game using mixed-integer programming
maximize_social_welfare: maximize social welfare by optimizing the sum of Nash payoffs for both players
minimize_social_welfare: minimize social welfare by optimizing the negative sum of Nash payoffs for both players
optimize_support_size: optimize the support size of Nash strategies by minimizing or maximizing the number of active pure strategies
maximize_gini_diversity: maximize strategy diversity by minimizing the sum of squared strategy probabilities for both players
